define i64 @ube.context.size() {
entry:

}
define void @ube.context.init(ptr %ctx) {
entry:
  br label %zero
zero:
  %index = phi i64 [ 0, %entry ], [ %next, %zero ]
  %slot = getelementptr i64, ptr %ctx, i64 %index
  store atomic volatile i64 0, ptr %slot monotonic, align 8
  %next = add i64 %index, 1
  %more = icmp ult i64 %next, {3}
  br i1 %more, label %zero, label %done
done:
  %program = getelementptr %ube.context, ptr %ctx, i32 0, i32 4
  call void @ube.thread.init(ptr %ctx, ptr %program, ptr null)
  ret void
}
define i1 @ube.context.dispose(ptr %ctx) {
entry:
  %depth.ptr = getelementptr %ube.thread, ptr %ctx, i32 0, i32 1
  %depth = load atomic i64, ptr %depth.ptr monotonic, align 8
  %depth.active = icmp ne i64 %depth, 0
  %files.empty = call i1 @ube.resource.empty(ptr %ctx)
  %files.live = xor i1 %files.empty, true
  %program = call ptr @ube.thread.program(ptr %ctx)
  %workers.ptr = getelementptr %ube.program, ptr %program, i32 0, i32 7
  %workers = load atomic i64, ptr %workers.ptr acquire, align 8
  %workers.live = icmp ne i64 %workers, 0
  %owners.active = or i1 %depth.active, %files.live
  %active = or i1 %owners.active, %workers.live
  br i1 %active, label %busy, label %threads
busy:
  ret i1 false
threads:
  %threads.disposed = call i1 @ube.thread.program.dispose(ptr %ctx)
  br i1 %threads.disposed, label %release, label %busy
release:

name: Entry
text:
@ube.entry.context = private global %ube.context zeroinitializer, align 8
define i32 @main() {
entry:
  call void @ube.context.init(ptr @ube.entry.context)
  %initialized = call i1 @ube.project.init(ptr @ube.entry.context)
  br i1 %initialized, label %invoke, label %unavailable
invoke:
  %result = call { i1, i64 } @ube.proc.{0}(ptr @ube.entry.context)
  %success = extractvalue { i1, i64 } %result, 0
  br i1 %success, label %complete, label %unavailable
complete:
  %value = extractvalue { i1, i64 } %result, 1
  %status = trunc i64 %value to i32
  br label %shutdown
unavailable:
  br label %shutdown
shutdown:
  %fresh.success = phi i1 [ true, %complete ], [ false, %unavailable ]
  %exit.status = phi i32 [ %status, %complete ], [ 1, %unavailable ]
  call void @ube.thread.root.complete(ptr @ube.entry.context, i1 %fresh.success)
  %drained = call i1 @ube.thread.drain(ptr @ube.entry.context)
  %disposed = call i1 @ube.context.dispose(ptr @ube.entry.context)
  %clean = and i1 %drained, %disposed
  ; Defensive native-launch transport status, never a successful UBE FAIL value.
  %final.status = select i1 %clean, i32 %exit.status, i32 1
  ret i32 %final.status
}

define internal i1 @ube.module.ensure.{0}(ptr %ctx) {
entry:

claim:

  %won = extractvalue { i64, i1 } %pair, 1
  br i1 %won, label %initialize, label %owner
owner:

  %same = icmp eq ptr %owning, %ctx
  br i1 %same, label %complete, label %inspect
initialize:

  %result = call { i1, i64 } @ube.module.initialize.{0}(ptr %ctx)
  store atomic ptr null, ptr %owner.ptr release, align 8
  store atomic i64 2, ptr %state.ptr release, align 8
  br label %complete
complete:

}
